# Support

Start with [usage](../docs/usage.md) and [troubleshooting](../docs/troubleshooting.md). For unresolved problems, [open an issue](https://github.com/netseye/passport-memo/issues/new/choose) with the commit, board, steps and sanitized errors. This is a community project; no response-time guarantee is offered.
